summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it won a competitive bid to provide hash-to-heat equipment (Avalon A1566HA series hydro-cooled units) to a Nordic district heating network. The filing describes a follow-on order in March 2026 for 6 MW of capacity (692 units) on top of 2 MW already operating (228 units). No financial terms, equity stake, price per share, premium, or deal structure are disclosed. There is no mention of a board recommendation, advisors, or regulatory clock. This is a routine business development press release, not a special-situation event.
